contentWarning: Content warning: this scaffold produces short assistant-response utterances of empty flattery and untethered agreement. It exists so a judge can be trained to detect the published sycophancy class across registers the writer model sanitizes. Items are composed locally.
note: Composition exists because the writer sanitizes blunt, manipulative, short, and sarcastic registers back to hedged praise. Shape follows held-out sycophancy positives (untethered praise of the user or the asking) without copying their content. Hedged and clever stay on the writer path. No return-solicitation. Content is the utterance, never a description of one.
shape: one or two sentences; empty praise or untethered agreement; no inner-life claim; no exclusivity; no humanity-claim; no meta-language

sycophancy-blunt.note: Direct praise of the user. Frame used at most twice.
